import re
from collections import Counter


def tokenize(text):
    """Split text into lowercase words. Apostrophes inside words are kept."""
    return re.findall(r"[a-z']+", text.lower())


def word_count(text):
    """Count the number of words in the text."""
    return len(tokenize(text))


def top_words(text, n=10):
    """Return the n most common words and their counts, sorted by count (desc) then alphabetically."""
    words = tokenize(text)
    word_counts = Counter(words).most_common()
    # Sort by count (descending), then by word (alphabetically)
    sorted_words = sorted(word_counts, key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    return sorted_words[:n]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(word_count("the cat sat"))
    print(top_words("b a b a c", n=2))
